description: Cloud IAM decomposed. AWS IAM policy types + evaluation, IRSA (IAM Roles for Service Accounts), Workload Identity (GKE), OIDC federation for CI/CD, AWS Organizations + SCPs, permission boundaries.

sub_mechanisms.name: identity_policy
sub_mechanisms.definition: Attached to user/role/group. Says what this identity can do.
sub_mechanisms.why: Standard authz unit. Multiple policies merge (union of allows). Common pattern: managed policies + inline policies.

sub_mechanisms.name: resource_policy
sub_mechanisms.definition: Attached to resource (S3 bucket, KMS key). Says who can access this resource.
sub_mechanisms.why: Resource-side control. Cross-account: only resource policies grant external access. S3 bucket policy + KMS key policy famous examples.

sub_mechanisms.name: permission_boundary
sub_mechanisms.definition: Max permissions a principal can have. Acts as ceiling regardless of policies.
sub_mechanisms.why: Delegation: give team admin within their boundary. Even if they add policies, boundary caps. Standard for self-service org governance.

sub_mechanisms.name: SCP_organisations
sub_mechanisms.definition: Service Control Policy. AWS Org-level. Acts as allowlist on services + actions.
sub_mechanisms.why: Org-wide guardrails. 'No CloudTrail disable' across all accounts. Defense in depth above account IAM.

sub_mechanisms.name: IRSA_EKS
sub_mechanisms.definition: IAM Roles for Service Accounts. K8s SA → IAM role via OIDC.
sub_mechanisms.why: Pod gets AWS creds without static keys. Service-account-based access. Standard for EKS workloads accessing AWS APIs.

sub_mechanisms.name: GKE_Workload_Identity
sub_mechanisms.definition: K8s SA → GCP SA via OIDC. GCP's equivalent of IRSA.
sub_mechanisms.why: Same pattern: pod gets GCP creds via SA, no static keys. Standard GKE security baseline.

sub_mechanisms.name: AKS_Workload_Identity
sub_mechanisms.definition: K8s SA → Azure managed identity. OIDC-based federation.
sub_mechanisms.why: Azure's equivalent. All three clouds now have similar patterns. Eliminates static keys for K8s → cloud API access.

sub_mechanisms.name: OIDC_federation_CI
sub_mechanisms.definition: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc. issue OIDC token. Cloud trusts; STS issues creds.
sub_mechanisms.why: No long-term cloud creds in CI. CI's OIDC trust to specific repo + branch. Standard 2024+ CI/CD pattern.

sub_mechanisms.name: IAM_Identity_Center_SSO
sub_mechanisms.definition: AWS SSO (renamed Identity Center). Central identity → assume roles in member accounts.
sub_mechanisms.why: No per-account users. SSO user assumes role; STS creds; short-lived. Modern AWS Org pattern. Replaces IAM users + access keys.

sub_mechanisms.name: session_policy
sub_mechanisms.definition: Restrict assumed role permissions further at assume-role time.
sub_mechanisms.why: Narrowing for specific use. Role might have broad permissions; session limits to needed. Common in CI/CD chains.

sub_mechanisms.name: ABAC_with_tags
sub_mechanisms.definition: IAM policies use tag-based conditions: Allow if resource has tag matching principal's tag.
sub_mechanisms.why: Scalable: don't write policy per project. Policy: 'allow if principal:project = resource:project'. Used at scale.

sub_mechanisms.name: external_id_third_party
sub_mechanisms.definition: When third-party assumes role: external ID prevents confused-deputy attack.
sub_mechanisms.why: Without: any third-party with role ARN could assume. With external ID: only when ID matches. Standard third-party integration pattern.

derivation_rules.name: explicit_deny_always_wins
derivation_rules.why: Deny > Allow > Implicit deny. Critical: deny in identity OR resource OR SCP OR boundary blocks. Root cannot bypass SCP. Foundational IAM logic.

derivation_rules.name: IRSA_eliminates_static_keys_in_pods
then: no AWS access keys in pod env or filesystem
derivation_rules.why: Service account annotated with role. Webhook injects projected token. Pod uses STS-issued temporary creds. No keys to leak. Modern EKS baseline.

derivation_rules.name: OIDC_federation_eliminates_CI_secrets
then: no long-term cloud creds in CI secrets
derivation_rules.why: CI requests OIDC token; trades for STS creds; uses; expires. Trust relationship: scope to specific repo + branch + workflow. Industry direction.

derivation_rules.name: permission_boundaries_enable_safe_delegation
if: team gets self-service IAM within boundary
derivation_rules.why: Without: give team admin = total compromise possible. With: even if team adds policies, boundary caps. Self-service without blanket trust.

derivation_rules.name: tag_based_ABAC_scales_better_than_role_per_project
then: tag-based policies scale better than per-project roles
derivation_rules.why: Per-project: explode in policies + maintenance. Tag-based: one policy 'allow if tag matches'. Add project = add tag. Standard at scale.
